systems.system: eID Togo (foundational unique identification system, fID)
systems.owner: Agence Nationale d'Identification (ANID); implementing agency the Ministère des Postes, de l'Economie Numérique et des Innovations; built by a contracted technology service provider and a registrations service provider; financed by the World Bank's WURI Phase 2 (P169594)
systems.tiers: proof of concept in four regions, October to November 2023; 8,000 individuals registered in a pilot by 15 December 2023; large-scale pilot under way; goal of 8 million registered by June 2024

systems.system: Link between the fID system and the civil registration system
systems.owner: provided for by Law No. 2020-009 of 10 September 2020 on biometric identification
systems.tiers: in law only; the programme-wide indicator of newborn birth registrations assigned a unique number stands at 0 per cent on 15 December 2023, across the four countries
